notes:
Stage Rotation now opens in its own windows instead of Microsoft Edge.

- The DJ screen, dressing-room screen and Dance Counter are app windows with the Stage Rotation name and icon. The old Edge windows close by themselves after the update.
- Closing the DJ window now asks whether to shut the app down.
- If the app windows can't start on this PC, it goes back to Edge windows by itself. Settings > This computer > "Screens open in" lets you choose.
